items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads A1 and dispensed into each of 96 wells, followed by 10 aspirate/dispense 40 uL mix cycles; incubation comment precedes the magnet comment.
The 'Engage magnetic module; wait 5 min' comment is recorded, then 90 uL is moved from each well to waste A1, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol in and 200 uL out for all 96 wells.
Comments record 5 min air dry, magnet disengage, 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage; 50 uL water is added to each well with 10 mix cycles at 40 uL.
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Every move() picks up a new tip and drops it, so each well has its own tip for beads, supernatant, ethanol, water and elution transfers; the log shows pick up/drop tip around each well.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates correctly and every volume, well pairing and mix count matches the log. Non-simulated steps (incubations, magnet engage/disengage, drying) are recorded by comments at the right points, and a fresh tip is used for every sample transfer.
